title: Tautline Lean Project Adapter (lean-1)
description: The post-bankruptcy project contract. It records project IDENTITY and the handful of facts an agent cannot infer -- name, repo, integration branch, how to run the tests, the project's own hard rules -- and nothing else. Process lives in prose in the generated adapter, not in configuration: there are no ceremony keys here because there is no ceremony left to configure. Written by `tautline slim`; validated by the stdlib validator in src/tautline_methodology/lean.py (no third-party runtime dependency).

schemaVersion.description: Contract version. The literal string that tells every reader this is a lean adapter and not a 1.x ceremony adapter.

project.description: Project identity. Preserved verbatim across the migration from a 1.x adapter.

repo.description: owner/name, or a URL. Empty for a local-only repo.

integrationBranch.description: The branch feature branches and PRs are based on. Migrated from latestCode.base / laneStatus.integrationBranch.

commands.description: The commands an agent cannot guess. `test` is THE gate.

review.description: Additional review focus, as one sentence of prose. The fresh-context self-review and different-model review always apply; this field cannot replace them. No round budget, ledger, manifest, or verdict machinery.

security.description: The checks that stay absolute. Toggles only -- there is no evidence file to produce.

release.description: Release is a batched script run when there is something to ship, not a per-PR gate.

upgradePathTest.description: Path to the test that proves a deployed user survives the release. The one release gate that stays.

workCoordination.description: Advisory work declarations. true enables local guidance; false or absent keeps explicit local declarations usable without guidance. The git object opts into sharing declarations through a dedicated remote branch, using existing Git permissions. Sync is bounded and fail-open; no edit/review/merge gates. Declared text is visible to repository readers, including the public for a public repository.

remote.description: An existing Git remote name, never a URL, path, or credential.

branch.description: Dedicated metadata branch; do not use a source or integration branch.

syncIntervalSeconds.description: Minimum interval between automatic refresh attempts during status/startup/work pickup. No background polling.

timeoutSeconds.description: Bounded sync time budget. Offline or failed sync reports uncertainty and retains local work.

laneStatus.description: `tautline lane-status` reports; it never blocks. The only accepted value says so.

handoffs.description: Continuity handoffs. When true, the generated adapter gains two lines telling the agent to read `.ai-continuity/HANDOFF.md` at session start and refresh it at checkpoints. `tautline lane-status` reports the file's freshness either way, once it exists.

backlog.description: Where this project's backlog lives. The configured provider is the SOURCE OF TRUTH and the project's exclusive backlog surface -- no BACKLOG.md, no TODO files, no local mirror. Moved only by `tautline backlog list|add|take|done`; nothing syncs. CREDENTIALS ARE NEVER IN THIS FILE, and `additionalProperties: false` is how the schema means it: github reads `gh` auth or GITHUB_TOKEN, jira reads JIRA_EMAIL + JIRA_API_TOKEN, and a `token` key here is refused rather than quietly accepted into a committed adapter. Absent means the local provider with QUEUE.md.

projectRules.description: Hard, project-specific facts an agent would otherwise get wrong -- one line each. Migrated from knownProjectRules and technologyStack.nonNegotiable. Facts about THIS project only; process norms belong in the generated adapter's prose.

builderGithub.description: Opt-in for the builder-lane GitHub verbs (`tautline board|issue|debt`): the ONLY GitHub Projects/issues surface a builder lane has. Names the product board (a GitHub ProjectV2) whose issues live in `project.repo`. Humans are never bound by this block; a lane is a builder only when TAUTLINE_ROLE=builder or .ai-work/lane-role says so. CREDENTIALS ARE NEVER IN THIS FILE.

hiddenStatuses.description: Columns `board list` hides unless asked for by name.

debtLabel.description: The one label `debt file` applies. Off-board by construction.
